construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit H19-031 (Site Permit, folder year 2019), status Approved, issue date 2022-08-09: "Site Development Permit to allow the construction of a 100% affordable housing project consisting of 14 multi-family residential units configured in four two-story buildings. The project includes an application under State Density Bonus Law including a 42" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

Initial Study (2022): 14 two-story townhomes, maximum height about 26 feet, in two duplexes and two five-unit buildings; rezoning from R-1-8 to MUN; Woodset Court connected to Woodset Drive through the parcel. It states construction would begin September 2021 with operation in April 2024.

Council memo (2022): vesting tentative map for 16 lots (14 residential lots of 787 to 1,574 sq ft and two common lots); about a 42% density bonus (4 units) with concessions for side and right-of-way setbacks, a parking reduction and a private open space waiver.
Housing memo (2020): Heritage Bank and Fremont Bank named as construction lenders on Habitat's current and past projects; other planned sources were County Measure A, FHLB AHP/WISH and HCD programs.
California Local (Nov 2022): the Board approved the funding on Nov. 1 as part of a $31.5 million Measure A package; the project is named Jackson Avenue Townhomes.
